role: exploratory image readout; never retroactively qualify P2 matches
color_masks: saturation>40, max>40; nearest normalized 6-color palette distance<.4
roi: projected cube corners +2px; pixel counts do not equal visibility fraction
color_correspondence: recorded getter invalid; infer from goal-image geometry by bijective assignment, require both views agree and >=5 color pixels in at least one view
dlp: not object identity; no per-step latents saved
